text:
Tess: Heads-up — planning to push console UI patch v3.12.1 today at 15:00 PST. Canary 10% for 15m, then ramp if no regressions. Primary goals: fix dropdown focus bug, small perf tweak to asset loading. @Miguel can you own CDN invalidation and cache priming? @Priya please own the smoke checklist and QA signoff.

Miguel: Ack, I can do CDN purge + warm. Which paths exactly? Are we purging all console assets or only hashed bundles? Also which CDN (Cloudflare/CF)?

Tess: Hosted uses Cloudflare for console assets. Purge these prefixes: `/static/console/` and `/assets/console/`. We only need to purge hashed bundles matching `main-*.js` and `vendor-*.js` plus CSS. Do NOT purge global libs. Edge TTL is 1h for non-hashed, 24h for hashed — so target hashed files.

Miguel: Got it. I'll run a targeted purge after canary deploy stabilizes (aiming ~2m after canary starts). Will also hit the top pages to warm edge cache. Purge command (Cloudflare API):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$ZONE_ID/purge_cache"
  -H "X-Auth-Email: deploy@redwood.ai"
  -H "X-Auth-Key: $CF_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  --data '{"files":["https://console.redwood.ai/static/console/main-<sha>.js","https://console.redwood.ai/assets/console/vendor-<sha>.js","https://console.redwood.ai/static/console/main-<sha>.css"]}'
```

Miguel: And warm by curl-ing index and main bundle on a few edges:
```
for host in edge1 edge2 edge3; do
  curl -s "https://console.redwood.ai/" -H "Host: $host" > /dev/null
  curl -s "https://console.redwood.ai/static/console/main-<sha>.js" -H "Host: $host" > /dev/null
done
```

Priya: QA plan: 1) login + org switch, 2) open workspace list, 3) open deployments page (list + details), 4) run quick smoke on load perf (LCP rough check). Canary duration ok? I'll need the canary build URL and a dev token for signin. Also, please add the minimal repro for the dropdown focus bug to the PR so I can validate quickly.

Tess: Canary duration 15m. Canary route will be `canary.console.redwood.ai` for the rollout. I'll attach the build URL in a sec. Dev token: @Jared can you generate a short-lived QA token for Priya?

Jared: Generating token now, will DM. Also adding rollback note: if we see regressions we do a fast rollback by redeploying the previous image tag `console@sha:abc123` to the same slot and skip the CDN purge (no purge required if we roll back to previous assets since they'll still be cached). If we need to force previous assets, we can re-issue a targeted purge for the new hashes only.

Priya: Cool. One more check: are feature flags toggled for the dropdown fix? Need to ensure we can flip off if something flaps.

Tess: Yes feature flag `ui.dropdown_improve` will be on for canary. We can flip it off instantly via the flag service (no deploy).

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: console v3.12.1 (canary 10% -> 100%), start 2029-05-03 23:00:00 UTC (15:00 PST). Canary window 15 minutes. Owner: Tess. Runbook: smoke checklist by Priya, CDN purge by Miguel, rollback tag `console@sha:abc123`.

Miguel: Quick verification steps I'll post in the release thread after purge. Also will monitor 200/500 rates on CDN and origin for 30m.

Priya: I'll post pass/fail for each smoke step in ~10m after canary. If anything fails, I'll ping here and tag @oncall.

Tess: Sweet. Final readiness check — please react with :thumbsup: if you're set. Miguel? Priya? Jared?

Miguel: :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup: 

Jared: :thumbsup:

Tess: Thanks team — deploying on schedule. I'll update with the canary build URL and the PR link now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4725
